entries.55a458e9d024e438: This division manufactures and sells mirin, wine and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, hon-mirin rose above the prior year, as value-added products centered on “Kome-koji Kodawari Shikomi Hon Mirin” performed steadily in the household segment, and the processing and food-service segment also rose above the prior year, while wine fell below the prior year, and the division as a whole fell below the prior year. Price revisions were made in March 2026 for cooking sake and liqueurs, due to rising raw material prices and other factors. Manns Wine Ltd. (Katsunuma Plant, Koshu City, Yamanashi Prefecture; Komoro Plant, Komoro City, Nagano Prefecture), Nagareyama Kikkoman Co., Ltd. and Terabēru Co., Ltd. are responsible.
entries.610d354d44ff40ad: This is the manufacture and sale of soy sauce overseas. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, in the North American market the company focused on expanding soy sauce-based seasonings and other products in addition to its core soy sauce in the household segment, and responded to customer needs in the processing and food service segment, exceeding the prior-year level; sales grew in Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands, among others, in Europe, and in Indonesia, the Philippines and China, among others, in Asia and Oceania. The North American production bases are the Walworth, Wisconsin headquarters plant of KIKKOMAN FOODS, INC. (carrying amount ¥27,275 million, 218 employees) and its California plant, and the company states that its third U.S. plant is scheduled to begin shipments in autumn 2026.
entries.65fcdaf82c20fd30: This division manufactures and sells soy sauce-related seasonings such as dipping sauces and sauces, Del Monte tomato processed products and canned goods, and ingredients for food service. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, dipping sauces rose above the prior year, and sauces overall fell below the prior year despite “Steak Shoyu” performing well; “Uchi no Gohan” saw the newly launched “Uchi no Gohan Vege” perform well, but “Mazegohan no Moto” fell below the prior year due in part to the impact of soaring rice market prices, while Del Monte seasonings rose above the prior year, and the division as a whole rose above the prior year. Price revisions were made in March 2026 for the Suriroshi series, due to rising raw material prices and other factors. Nippon Del Monte Corporation, Kikkoman Foodtech Co., Ltd., Saitama Kikkoman Co., Ltd., Takara Shoyu Co., Ltd. and Nippon Del Monte Agri Co., Ltd. are responsible.
entries.68fc4177ecbd1c8f: This division manufactures and sells canned fruit, corn products, tomato ketchup and other products in the Asia and Oceania region. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales for the division as a whole exceeded the prior-year level. DEL MONTE ASIA PTE LTD, SIAM DEL MONTE COMPANY LIMITED (Thailand), Dimen Shipin (Xiamen) Youxian Gongsi and Dimen (Guangzhou) Maoyi Youxian Gongsi are responsible for it. The foundation of this division is the acquisition in January 1990 of the permanent exclusive right to use the Del Monte trademark in Japan and the Asia-Pacific region (excluding the Philippines).
entries.699f65e32c54bbd6: This segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and chemical products, leases real estate, operates transportation services, and provides indirect business services within the group. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥7,528 million (¥21,765 million including inter-segment revenue, 100.9% of the prior-year figure), and segment profit (business profit) was ¥1,627 million (138.8% of the prior-year figure). The company states that sales of clinical diagnostic enzymes and sanitary testing agents and of hyaluronic acid exceeded the prior-year level, while the transportation business fell below the prior-year level. Kikkoman Biochemifa Co., Ltd. (Kamogawa Plant, Kamogawa City, Chiba Prefecture; Edogawa Plant, Noda City, Chiba Prefecture) is responsible for pharmaceuticals and various enzyme and chemical products, Sobu Butsuryu Co., Ltd. for transportation and warehousing, Kikkoman Business Service Co., Ltd. for indirect business services, and Sobu Service Center Co., Ltd. for contract manufacturing and business outsourcing. Kibun Fresh System Co., Ltd. is an equity-method affiliate with a voting rights ownership ratio of 15.00%. This segment applies the fermentation and brewing technologies cultivated in soy sauce brewing to non-food uses, and it is the reportable segment with the smallest revenue from external customers. The segment has 570 employees (plus an average of 87 temporary employees per year).
entries.6e205dbe7c744dbd: This category purchases and sells Toyo Shokuhin and other products in Japan and overseas. Of the four reportable [[term:segment|segments]], it is the largest. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥432.8 billion (¥432,941 million including intersegment revenue, 106.2% of the prior-year period), which is more than half of consolidated revenue of ¥745,539 million. The company states that sales grew steadily in North America, Europe and Asia/Oceania. Segment profit (business profit) was ¥30,668 million (100.8% of the prior-year period), with the North American and European markets above the prior year and the Asian and Oceanian markets below the prior year. Unlike the manufacturing and sales category, which sells products it makes itself, this is a business that earns by delivering food products purchased from other producers. The companies responsible are JFC INTERNATIONAL INC. (US; revenue of the company and its four consolidated subsidiaries was US$1,967,936,000), JFC Japan Co., Ltd., JFC INTERNATIONAL (EUROPE) GmbH, JFC HONG KONG LIMITED, JFC (S) PTE. LTD., and other companies in North America, Europe and Asia/Oceania. The company cites as future challenges building a well-balanced business structure between the food-service and household markets, and strengthening its logistics infrastructure, personnel, procurement capabilities and capacity to develop its own-brand products. The number of employees is 2,357 (in addition, an annual average of 67 temporary employees).

entries.a3d6a4698bbc5409: This category manufactures and sells soy sauce, food, beverages and alcoholic beverages in Japan, and consists of four divisions: the Soy Sauce Division, Food Division, Beverage Division and Alcoholic Beverage Division. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥155,718 million (¥160,138 million including intersegment revenue, 103.8% of the prior-year period), and segment profit (business profit) was ¥9,886 million (115.9% of the prior-year period), an increase in both revenue and profit. The company states that the Alcoholic Beverage Division was below the prior year, while the Soy Sauce, Food and Beverage Divisions were above the prior year. Kikkoman Foods, Inc. (revenue of ¥108,431 million; 911 employees, the most in the group), Hokkaido Kikkoman Co., Ltd., Nippon Del Monte Corporation, Kikkoman Foodtech Co., Ltd., Saitama Kikkoman Co., Ltd., Takara Shoyu Co., Ltd., Kikkoman Soyfoods Co., Ltd., Manns Wine Ltd., Nagareyama Kikkoman Co., Ltd., Terabēru Co., Ltd. and Nippon Del Monte Agri Co., Ltd. are responsible, and Higeta Shoyu Co., Ltd. is an equity-method associate (voting rights held: 28.38%). The number of employees is 2,556 (in addition, an annual average of 253 temporary employees).
entries.aea980b65ceec9a5: This is the manufacture and sale of soy sauce in Japan. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, in the household segment, the company continued marketing measures that conveyed product added value, centered on TV advertising, and the “Itsudemo Shinsen” series exceeded the prior year, while pet bottle products such as “Koikuchi Shoyu” fell below the prior year; the household segment as a whole was at about the prior-year level, the food-service and processing segment fell below the prior year, and the division as a whole was at about the prior-year level. Kikkoman Foods, Inc. and Hokkaido Kikkoman Co., Ltd. are responsible, and Higeta Shoyu Co., Ltd. is an equity-method associate. The main plants are the Noda Plant (Noda City, Chiba Prefecture) and the Takasago Plant (Takasago City, Hyogo Prefecture) of Kikkoman Foods, Inc.

entries.bba7394dbc5c39f9: It is one of the three divisions that make up the Overseas Food Manufacturing and Sales Business; the securities report states in its segment overview: 'The company manufactures and sells soy sauce, Del Monte products and other food products overseas, and also conducts export sales to overseas markets.' The securities report does not disclose individual sales or product breakdowns.
entries.c183ecab73a50992: This segment manufactures and sells soy sauce, Del Monte products and other food products overseas, and also conducts export sales to overseas markets. It consists of the Soy Sauce Division, the Del Monte Division and the Other Food Products Division. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥149,491 million (¥173,506 million including inter-segment revenue, 103.8% of the prior-year figure), and segment profit (business profit) was ¥40,929 million (102.7% of the prior-year figure). Although the Overseas Food Wholesale Business is larger in revenue, this segment has the largest business profit of the four reportable segments, exceeding the ¥30,668 million of the wholesale business. KIKKOMAN FOODS, INC. (Wisconsin, U.S.), KIKKOMAN SALES USA, INC. (revenue of US$679.893 million), KIKKOMAN FOODS EUROPE B.V. (Netherlands), KIKKOMAN TRADING EUROPE GmbH, KIKKOMAN (S) PTE. LTD., KIKKOMAN AUSTRALIA PTY. LIMITED, PT. KIKKOMAN AKUFOOD INDONESIA, Kunshan Tongwan Weishengwu Keji Youxian Gongsi, Tongwan Zhenji Shipin Youxian Gongsi, Tongwan Gufen Youxian Gongsi, DEL MONTE ASIA PTE LTD, SIAM DEL MONTE COMPANY LIMITED and others are responsible for this segment. The segment has 1,766 employees (plus an average of 1 temporary employee per year).

entries.e19a60ee510f08c7: This division manufactures and sells soy milk beverages, vegetable and fruit beverages and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, soy milk beverages rose above the prior year, as active advertising and in-store sales promotion helped the health value gain recognition, with unadjusted soy milk and the 200 ml size performing particularly well; Del Monte beverages were at about the prior-year level, as tomato juice and the newly launched “Pyure Furūtsu” performed well but some products were discontinued, and the division as a whole rose above the prior year. Kikkoman Soyfoods Co., Ltd. (625 employees) is responsible, and produces at its Gifu Plant (Mizuho City, Gifu Prefecture), Saitama Plant (Sayama City, Saitama Prefecture) and Ibaraki Plant (Sashima District, Ibaraki Prefecture).
